t: Can be used as a collection point for feeding bees. It holds 3 item blocks. When Lumber or Quarry bees feed from this it will produce from a random item in the feeder.
可作为喂食蜜蜂的集中供料点。它可容纳 3 个物品方块。当伐木或采石蜜蜂从这里取食时，会从喂食器中的随机物品产出对应资源。
Feeding slabs can be honeylogged giving the bees an excellent place to dip their toes and recover from a long day of works, aka it gives them regeneration.
喂食台可以注入蜂蜜，为蜜蜂提供一个绝佳的歇脚之处，让它们在辛苦工作一天后恢复状态——也就是给予它们生命恢复效果。
Since a $(l:items/upgrades#simulator)simulated hive$(/l) only has 1 flowerblock position, feeding slabs work very well with them, letting you have up to 3 different bees working in the hive.
由于$(l:items/upgrades#simulator)模拟蜂箱$(/l)只有 1 个花朵方块位置，喂食台与它非常搭配，让你最多可以让 3 种不同的蜜蜂在同一个蜂箱中工作。
